purpose: Algorithm-free finite-performance restrictions for GadgetPickup; exploratory model comparison, not a preregistered causal analysis.
demand: Unchanged observation-corrected additive model, five SHA256 whole-listing folds, exact ask-grid counterfactuals.
eligible: Continuation listings (since_seen>0); joint changes update all own-peer price terms; entrants held unchanged, including their profit spillovers.
performance: Pi0(c) >= (1-rho)*max(0,Pi_k(c):k in comparison family). Thus participation plus limited approximate local optimality. rho is an assumption, not estimated.
demand_sensitivity: Multiply only counterfactual log-odds displacement by scale; factual fitted probabilities unchanged. This is a transparent stress test, not a confidence set.
costs: Nonnegative, persistent within listing, heterogeneous across listings, no upper cap or equality imposed.
interpretation: One-step conditional expected-payoff comparisons on retained observed histories. Current-action shifts are restricted swap deviations, not consequences of contextual external ANR. No automatic path-counterfactual, finite-sample statistical coverage, acquisition-cost claim, or calibrated numerical rho.
